Long initial sessions to listen deeply, review history, and begin an individualized plan. Focused, supportive, and practical.

  • Comprehensive intake

Schedule a discovery

Where we begin: a careful diagnostic conversation

We gather your story, labs, lifestyle patterns, and goals to form a clear, teachable picture of health. No magic promises — just thoughtful education and planful care.

Comprehensive intake

Medical history, nutrition, sleep, stress and movement — we map what matters for your day-to-day life.

Targeted learning

We translate labs and symptoms into understandable, usable insights so you can make confident choices.

Collaborative options

Educational referrals and optional labs (when appropriate) help refine the plan; you remain in control.

Personalized plan: practical, measurable, and kind

We synthesize findings into a clear roadmap: prioritized steps, expected timelines, and simple metrics to track progress.

1. Priorities

We pick 2–3 high-impact changes to start with — attainable shifts that respect your life.

2. Tools & education

Nutrition guidance, sleep hygiene, stress tools, and movement recommendations tailored to you.

3. Checkpoints

Scheduled follow-ups and measurable markers to see what’s working and adjust as needed.

Micro-habits: small daily choices that add up

Tiny, repeatable actions reduce friction and build momentum. These are science-friendly habits you can actually keep.

Wake window: Aim for a consistent 20-minute morning routine to set tone for the day.
Bite balance: Add a simple protein + vegetable to one meal to stabilize energy.
Evening wind-down: 30 minutes of low-light activity to cue restful sleep.
Breathe: Two rounds of 4–6 breath cycles mid-day to reset stress reactivity.

These suggestions are educational. They are not medical guarantees. Individual results vary.

Investments — designed for deep change

Intensive packages for people ready to commit to meaningful shifts. Transparent care, predictable follow-up.
